# source: tex/leantex.sty and docs/guide.md's "Code files" section: the
# \inputlean[options]{file} command, whose options are show, decls,
# proofs, link, facts, bibliography, biblio-style and phrase. entries.
# Under lualatex the package sets the whole file through minted's
# \inputminted and warns when an option asks for more.
# The engine reads the file as a Lean file: show = code with no decls,
# proofs or link includes it whole, as one listing, and asks Lean nothing;
# the other options ask the file's project's Lean, which these rows never
# need. The included file is invented and committed beside the index.
body impl \inputlean{fixtures/example.lean}
body impl \inputlean[show = code]{fixtures/example.lean}
body refuse:W0110 \inputlean[proofs = folded]{fixtures/example.lean}
